name: batch-08
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A suspended open geometric mobile made of golden straw tubes and fine tan thread, shaped as two pyramids joined at their square base with a smaller hanging diamond below; preserve the hollow framework and visible joints.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A miniature tan wooden sailboat on a dark simple display cradle, with a low brown hull, one central wooden mast and two unequal cream triangular sails; no water, passengers, lettering or extra nautical emblems.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A pale sage ceramic incense burner with an open rounded bowl, cream rim and three short feet, holding one slender brown incense stick with a faint curl of gray smoke; preserve the current scene's single-stick presentation.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A cream ceramic picture plaque on a small tan wooden easel, painted with a simple sage landscape curve and one warm ochre divided window; retain the original domestic scene, without adding sacred portraits or lettering.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A tan faceted wooden draw-stick box with a narrow stick emerging upward, beside one tall cream paper slip bearing only a few short brown horizontal marks; keep the box and paper distinct, without invented readable predictions.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A warm tan woven basket with a tall curved handle and folded white cloth liner, holding one small golden round bread loaf and one muted pink decorated egg; keep the limited two-food arrangement.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A deep muted gray-green metal cooking pot with two loop handles, filled with warm brown thick food; a tan wooden stirring paddle leans upward from its center, with one curved swirl visible on the surface.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A low green folded-leaf floating vessel with layered pointed leaf edges, one small ivory flower and one short cream candle with a warm golden flame; a small blue water ripple sits underneath, with no airborne lantern envelope.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: A warm brass rounded bell with a dark curved sound slit, suspended on a thick cream rope with a short reddish-tan flared pull tassel below; keep the bell, rope and tassel clearly separated.
